title: Require Repository Script Topology
forbids: a repository scripts root outside its closed mechanics and content topology, or a missing admitted script owner
why: Repository scripts are bounded mechanics and content assets with explicit owners. Closing their root prevents orchestration, policy, and product concerns from accumulating in an unowned script namespace.
remediate: Keep only AGENTS.md and the chatgpt-corpus-template, dev, githooks, and habitat roots directly under scripts. Move other concerns to their declared product, policy, or tool owner.
message: Repository scripts must retain their closed mechanics and content topology.
